text:
alex: Quick heads-up: PR #4528 (model-proxy) has a tiny whitespace diff from the linter — trailing spaces in proto enums. CI is blocking merge. Anyone available for a 5min fix? Want to land before EOD merge slot.

rachael: I can take it. Is it just trailing spaces or do we also need to run gofumpt?

sam: likely trailing spaces mostly. CI log shows "proto: trailing-whitespace at protos/examples.proto:42". Minimal.

alex: thanks @rachael. Running local fmt now. Patch will be tiny. ps — also renamed field from userID -> user_id in last commit, check tests.

ci-bot: buildkite: PR #4528 — lint failed (proto-lint). Link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/4528/logs/123

rachael: pushing fix in a sec. Patch:

```diff
diff --git a/protos/examples.proto b/protos/examples.proto
-  ENUM_VAL = 1;␣
+  ENUM_VAL = 1;
```

rachael: done — pushed fix to branch alex/pr-4528-whitespace-fix

sam: running quick presub. lgtm from me if CI green. :thumbsup: 

lee: small nit: can we keep the proto field name as `user_id` not `userId`? Looks like it's already `user_id` in this PR but double-check.

alex: confirmed it's `user_id`. thanks. tagging for merge.

ci-bot: buildkite: PR #4528 — all checks passed ✅

rachael: squashed and force-pushed. anyone want to merge or should I request a spot in merge queue?

sam: i'll merge during the 2pm window.

alex: appreciate it — leaving a LGTM here. :shipit:
